Bug_Title: Eq: equals method always returns false (EQ_ALWAYS_FALSE)
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by overriding the equals method to always return false. This violates the reflexivity requirement of the equals method, making an object not equal to itself.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test cases trigger the bug by calling the `showBug` method with the same object (`obj1.showBug(obj1)`) and different objects (`obj1.showBug(obj2)`). Since the `equals` method always returns false, the `showBug` method should return 1 (true), but it returns 0 (false), causing the test cases to fail.
